content: react.dev useEffect reference: effects run after commit; when caused by an interaction (click) React may run the effect BEFORE the browser paints - so a click-driven view-swap focus() lands pre-paint (no flicker). Intra-component effects run in declaration order (already codebase-proven, ArticleView jump-vs-restore). Cross-component child-before-parent effect ordering within one commit is long-standing React behavior but NOT explicitly documented on the useEffect page - do not make the design depend on it; prefer per-view ownership of focus so ordering questions vanish. StrictMode double-invokes setup+cleanup in dev (test hydration assumption).
